description: One committed move of a task on a delegate board: the task, the agent it came from and the agent it went to. The board raises at most ONE of these per reader action and changes nothing itself — the host applies the move to its own data and re-renders. The same record describes an assignment (From null, To set), a return to the backlog (To null) and a hand-over between two agents (both set), so a host that only cares about "who holds it now" reads AssigneeId and ignores the rest.

members.name: AssigneeId
members.description: The agent id the host should store on the task now, or null for the backlog.

members.name: From
members.description: The agent the task came from, or null when it came from the backlog.

members.name: IsAssignment
members.description: Whether the task was handed to an agent (from the backlog or from another agent).

members.name: IsHandover
members.description: Whether the task moved between two DIFFERENT agents. A "move" to the agent that already holds it is not a change and the board never reports one.

members.name: IsUnassignment
members.description: Whether the task went back to the backlog.

members.name: Task
members.description: The task that moved, as the host supplied it.

members.name: To
members.description: The agent that holds the task now, or null when it went back to the backlog.
